newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Bomb blast kills one man, injures two in Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Bomb blast kills one man, injures two in Karachi.

text.p: A small bomb blew up in a video shop in the southern Pakistani port city of Karachi on Wednesday, killing a man and injuring two, police said.
There was no immediate information about who set off the bomb in the crowded Lea Market area in southern Karachi, Pakistan's commercial hub.
They quoted shop owner Mohammad Siddique as saying he was sitting behind a counter when he heard the blast and saw pieces of flying glass.
A shop employee, Faqeer Mohammad, 40, was killed and two people, one an 11-year-old-boy, were injured.
More than 2,500 people, including 300 security officials, have died in political and ethnic violence in Karachi since 1995.
However, the city has remained comparatively calm for the past several months.
